document.title: PP 50/2025: Keringanan iuran JKK/JKM pekerja bukan penerima upah

delta.note: The regulation grants a 50% JKK/JKM contribution relief only to non-wage-earning participants (Peserta Bukan Penerima Upah), meaning workers outside an employment relationship or self-employed workers. It does not touch permanent employees (pegawai tetap), whose employer-paid JKK/JKM premiums enter PPh 21 gross income. It therefore does not change any PPh 21 calculation for permanent employees.
